seo.title: 5-Day Morocco Imperial Cities Tour from Casablanca | Chefchaouen & Fes (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €490 pp. 5-day private cultural tour from Casablanca to Fes. Visit Hassan II Mosque, Rabat, Chefchaouen blue medina, Roman Volubilis & medieval Fes.
seo.lead: A 5-day private cultural immersion across northern Morocco's imperial capitals and mountain settlements. Starting in Casablanca at the iconic Hassan II Mosque, the journey visits the political capital of Rabat, the blue-washed alleys of Chefchaouen in the Rif Mountains, the preserved Roman city of Volubilis, imperial Meknes, and concludes with an in-depth guided exploration of medieval Fes.

price.label: From EUR 490 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned vehicle with dedicated Berber driver-guide, 4 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Chefchaouen, Fes), guided walking tour in Fes el-Bali with licensed local guide, monument entrance coordination, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Blue-painted steps and doorways of Chefchaouen medina during a 5-day northern Morocco imperial cities tour from Casablanca
highlights: Marvel at the architectural splendor and towering ocean minaret of the Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca
Tour the ancient Kasbah of the Udayas and Mohammed V Mausoleum in the capital city of Rabat
Stroll the photogenic blue streets, artisan weaving shops, and relaxed plazas of Chefchaouen
Walk among the remarkably preserved Roman triumph arches, basilicas, and mosaics at UNESCO Volubilis
Admire the monumental 18th-century Bab Mansour gate and royal granaries in imperial Meknes
Comprehensive guided historical walking tour inside the world's largest living medieval medina in Fes

faqs.question: Is this 5-day tour focused primarily on culture and architecture?
faqs.answer: Yes. This itinerary is tailored for travelers who want to dive deep into Morocco's imperial architecture, UNESCO world heritage landmarks, artisan handicrafts, and culinary traditions without long desert driving legs.

faqs.question: Can this tour return to Casablanca instead of ending in Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. On Day 5, after completing your guided morning exploration of Fes, your private driver can easily transfer you back to Casablanca or Casablanca Airport (approx. 3 hours via highway).

faqs.question: How much time is spent exploring the blue medina of Chefchaouen?
faqs.answer: You arrive in Chefchaouen on Day 2 in the early afternoon and stay overnight, giving you the late afternoon golden hour and early morning quiet before day-tripper crowds arrive.

faqs.question: Is a certified local guide included for the medina of Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A licensed historical expert accompanies you in Fes to explore Al-Qarawiyyin University, Bou Inania Madrasa, the Nejjarine woodworking museum, and the centuries-old Chouara leather tanneries.

faqs.question: Are private airport transfers included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pickup on Day 1 is coordinated directly from Casablanca Mohammed V Airport (CMN) or your city hotel, and final drop-off is provided to Fes Saïss Airport (FEZ) or your next destination.
